what: Hand check of version 5's published website items by a person, Ruby Goyal, on 3 November 2026. She opened each source herself, without the agent's code or Claude's verdicts. Claude's own cross-check of the same items (2 November) is in examples/cross-check-v5.json; both verdicts are listed per item.
sample: The same 52 items as the cross-check: 16 companies from Builderr's company list whose website version 5 verified on 1 November 2026 (12 drawn at random, 4 whose careers pages the agent read): each verified website, its social accounts, up to three dated news posts, and each job decision.

different.company: FORENINGEN FOR OMPLASSERING AV DYR FOD
different.why: The page changed between the checks: on 1 and 2 November it said "Vi har for tiden ingen ledige stillinger"; on 3 November it showed a new part-time opening (deadline 13 November) written on the careers page itself.

The careers page links to a job list loaded by a script from Workable. It shows five "Åpen søknad" (open application) postings by city and a staffing-pool posting, no specific vacancy. The agent does not count open applications as openings; the hand check counted them as open roles.

cant_tell_reasons: Two Instagram accounts could not be opened without a login (items 2 and 6). Item 2 (helleland) was found wrong by Claude's cross-check, a sole proprietor's private account, and is no longer published.

Six news posts (Homely, Tre Team) show no date on the page (items 24-26, 49-51). The dates are in the page's metadata (article:published_time), the site's feed and, for Tre Team, the post's address; Claude's cross-check and the Momentic QA run confirmed them there.
Hapro's linked job list did not display (item 20). Claude's cross-check found two open applications there, both at subsidiaries.

wrong_and_what_changed.what: Live job ads behind the careers page's Jobylon list were missed.
wrong_and_what_changed.now: Fixed in version 5 after Claude's cross-check: the agent reads the Jobylon list, and all 6 live ads are published.

wrong_and_what_changed.company: FORENINGEN FOR OMPLASSERING AV DYR FOD
wrong_and_what_changed.what: A new opening was posted on the careers page after the run (see above).
wrong_and_what_changed.now: The 1 November answer matched the page at the time.

wrong_and_what_changed.what: Open applications counted as open roles by the hand check (see above).
wrong_and_what_changed.now: Unchanged by design: an open application is not a specific opening.

missed_noted_by_the_hand_check: FOD: the new part-time opening on its careers page; Facebook FODOSLO, Instagram fodoslo and TikTok fodoslo (handles with a place word the legal name does not carry).
Homely: three current vacancies linked from its careers page (published since the Jobylon fix).

Idrettsforeningen Fløya: Instagram floyaoffisiell (the site also presents another company carrying the brand, Fløya Anlegg AS), and the post "Bli en del av Fløya-familien!" (2026-06-17; found by the agent, outside the three posts per company shown in the sample).
Indre Kåfjord barne- og ungdomsskole: Facebook ikskole (the site's own short domain name, not a word of the legal name).
Inventura: Facebook InventuraBergenOslo (place words), and the open applications on its Workable list.
Personaltjenester Telemark: Facebook Personaltjenester (the bare brand, for a company whose name carries a region).

Tre Team Entreprenør: Facebook treteam (another company named on the site, Treteam AS, carries the brand), and the post "Påskeferie 2026" (dated only by its address, 2026/03/27, while the homepage card shows the holiday's end date).
EEG Laboratoriet: Facebook and YouTube leads whose ownership could not be confirmed.
